authorization: User requested a full run if the DexMachina-inspired candidate was promising.
method: Native CHORD PPO with the already tested DexMachina-inspired reward/completion curriculum and reset mixture; no WM or added wrench reward
optimizer_changes: None; native KL-adaptive LR, 5 epochs and 4 minibatches; restore current LR and complete learner state
curriculum_changes: None; restore current stage, history and decisions, including current assistance 1.0
resume_semantics: Native checkpoint restores all dynamic learner leaves (weights, optimizers, observation normalization, PRNG, adaptive LR and counters). Physics and controller history reset through native resume, so not bitwise continuous simulation.
resume_integration: Eight iterations from the saved 60M checkpoint in a separate disposable-output experiment. Full continuation starts from the original 60M checkpoint, not integration output.
evaluation: After learner exits, evaluate checkpoints at approximately 100/150/200/250/300/350M. 16 worlds, frame zero, zero assistance; preserve raw poses and mesh and independently cross-check AUC, SP-SR, MP-SR, MPPE. Evaluation failure does not suppress other checkpoint evaluations.
budget_interpretation: 350M matches the previous full FlashSAC comparison. This is not the default G1 PPO recipe's 20000 iterations x 4096 worlds x 24 = 1966080000 transitions.
projection: At the measured roughly 65000 transitions/s, about 75-85 additional training minutes plus setup and evaluation; not a convergence promise.
artifact_policy: Keep original checkpoints and all new checkpoints/logs/source. Do not automatically extend or restart. Keep the prepaid instance on.
reporting: 00/06/12/18 America/New_York; pause summaries after final outcome. Local one-episode input-reference scores, not official leaderboard results.
